amendments.A-01: GAP-1: CapabilityOut.seniorities lists the seniorities the Problem targets and offers (every seniority named by a bar part; PR-9), in the presented order, derived by the server from the version that would be pinned; empty unless practice_ready. No bar or level-expectation text is released to populate it.
amendments.A-02: GAP-2: ChallengeStageOut.subsections lists, for ml_reasoning only, the ML sub-sections the pinned Problem authors (ml_objective, data, features, labels, model, training, inference, in that order) as {key, title}: key is the legal stage field identifier of that sub-prompt, title a fixed label. A sub-section the Problem does not author is never listed. Presentation only; no new position.
amendments.A-03: GAP-3: ChallengeStageOut.hints_available is the TOTAL number of the stage's authored hints released to the caller under the current plan; ChallengeStageOut.hints_used is how many of those the learner has been shown, from the event record (never from the bounded history). Remaining is hints_available minus hints_used. HintOut carries the same two numbers after the hint.
amendments.A-04: GAP-4: ChallengeOut.prompt is a list of canonical blocks: {type: markdown, text} (Markdown rendered as text: paragraphs, lists, emphasis, code spans) and {type: callout, kind: note|tip|warning, children: [markdown blocks]}. Any other directive in the givens is dropped, never passed through.
amendments.A-05: OI-02: AttemptDetailOut.history holds at most the 200 most recent learner-visible events in ascending seq, and AttemptDetailOut.history_total counts them all. Truncation is never silent: older events stay stored unchanged and are exported. Hint usage and revealed clarifications are reported in full by their own members, so a bounded history never makes a used hint available again.
amendments.A-06: OI-03: a repeated POST .../reveal on an ended_by_reveal attempt answers 200 with the same AttemptOut and no second effect (no second event), as abandon does on an abandoned attempt. Reveal or abandon on any other non-active status answers 409 attempt_not_active with status.
amendments.A-07: Create admits only a caller whose practice-data consent is accepted at the required version (spec 4.1). Otherwise it answers 409 consent_version_stale with document_id practice-data and required_version, which is null while the required version is unset (fail closed).
amendments.A-08: POST .../hint when every hint of the stage released to the caller has been shown answers 404 stage_not_available, as does a position outside the attempt's spine.
amendments.A-09: M1 creates self-mode attempts only: a create with mode ai answers 409 practice_not_ready (the Problem is not offered for AI practice) and writes nothing.
amendments.A-10: ReferenceOut.rubric lists the rubric dimensions the caller may self-review now (the grant that admits PUT .../self-review/{dimension_id}), in document order, as {dimension_id, title, stage, bar, strong_evidence, weak_evidence, self_review}: stage is the interview stage of the dimension's for= target or null; bar holds only the attempt's target-seniority bar (null when the Problem has none for it); evidence parts are canonical blocks; self_review is the learner's saved {dimension_id, mark, note, version} or null. Never the evaluates part, another seniority's bar, or any trace of a dimension the caller may not read; empty whenever sections would be withheld for the whole Problem.
amendments.A-11: P9-T18 privacy access during a practice shutdown (release requirement A): while PRACTICE_PRIVACY_ACCESS is true, export_all, export_attempt, delete_attempt, delete_all, get_consent, withdraw_consent and list_attempts skip both practice_disabled checks of check_order (PRACTICE_ENABLED and the rollout admission); the token (401), user_id ownership, private no-store, the journal key check and the authored-content filtering of the export still apply. list_attempts stays the read-only AttemptListPage of the caller's own attempts (no detail, stage work, diagram, hint, reference or rubric). Every other route, including post_consent, create_attempt and get_attempt, keeps check_order. With the flag false (the default) nothing changes.

never_serialized: reference solution or any reference or review section
hint text before it is requested
rubric, bars, evaluator or fixture material
a withheld Premium section, or any count, ID or flag of one
internal prompts, model IDs, content commit, plan or route at start, ledger or job state
rules: built field by field from the pinned Problem version; the whole Problem document is never serialized
an unrevealed clarification answer is never present; a revealed one appears only in revealed_clarifications
reference sections are served only by get_reference
challenge is null while the authored material is withdrawn; the learner's own work stays

completions.C-01: GET /capability: `content_id` is optional; absent, `practice_ready` is false.
completions.C-02: Success statuses are not stated by the spec: 201 for create attempt, 204 for deletes, 200 elsewhere (P7 convention).
completions.C-03: Routes whose model section 6.5 names by purpose are mapped to it (hint, reveal clarification, assumption, turn, submit, reference, self-review, preference, consent); PUT diagram returns DiagramOut like GET diagram.
completions.C-04: Graph optionality: `subtype` and `boundary` are nullable; `label`, `explanation` and `tag` default to an empty string; `kind` defaults to `request`; node, edge and boundary IDs take their own prefix (n_, e_, b_).
completions.C-05: Layout document: the `schema` marker and the container names nodes, edges (waypoint lists), boundaries and viewport are named here; the contract names only their contents.
completions.C-06: InterviewerOut, EvaluationOut and RetryInfo are PROVISIONAL (M2) and embedded only as always-null M1 members.

conventions.authentication: Authorization: Bearer <Supabase JWT>; user_id is the verified sub and is never read from a path, query, header or body
conventions.cache_control: private, no-store on every answer under the prefix, errors included
check_order: PRACTICE_ENABLED off: 403 practice_disabled, whatever the token
PRACTICE_ROLLOUT does not admit the caller: 403 practice_disabled
conventions.ownership: every query filters by user_id; another user's ID and a malformed ID both answer 404, never 403
conventions.request_bodies: JSON, unknown keys refused with 422 validation_error

decisions.G-01: PATCH .../stages/{position} answers 200 with StageWorkOut: the canonical saved stage (position, status, new version, fields, updated_at).
decisions.G-02: GET .../attempts/{id} answers AttemptDetailOut: AttemptOut plus stage_work (saved fields), the allowlisted challenge of the pinned Problem version (null while withdrawn), revealed clarifications and the learner-visible history. Created by explicit field allowlist, never from the whole Problem document; no reference, unrevealed answer, hint text, evaluator material, withheld section or prompt. The list keeps AttemptListItem; reference retrieval stays in get_reference.
decisions.G-03: POST .../abandon (no body) moves active to abandoned, keeps saved work and history, is not deletion, answers 200 with the canonical AttemptOut, and a repeat on an abandoned attempt answers the same state with no second effect. The owning task implements it.
decisions.G-04: POST .../reveal takes RevealIn {confirm: true} (anything else is 422 validation_error), applies the approved active to ended_by_reveal transition and answers 200 with AttemptOut. It carries no reference content; reference authorization stays with the reference route.
decisions.G-05: DELETE one and DELETE all answer 204 with no body.
decisions.G-06: GET /consent answers ConsentStatusOut (practice_data and practice_ai, separate purposes); POST /consent/withdraw takes ConsentWithdrawIn and answers ConsentWithdrawOut. A POST /consent whose document_version is not the required one answers 409 consent_version_stale with document_id and required_version. practice-voice is not frozen. The owning task implements persistence.
decisions.G-07: Layout numbers are finite: coordinates -100000 to 100000, width and height above 0 and at most 100000, zoom 0.1 to 4; the 65536-byte limit is kept. They apply to node and boundary frames, route waypoints and the viewport. Semantic enforcement belongs to the diagram service.
decisions.G-08: The self-mode stage turn keeps its required Idempotency-Key. The lifecycle service owns the ledger enforcement.
decisions.G-09: Each export line type has an allowlisted data model (Export*Line) over the learner's own data, reusing canonical models where every member is learner data. Never exported: secrets, provider configuration, prompts, ledger, jobs, alias maps, content commits, model metadata, reference or unrevealed material. The export service implements the stream.

diagram.enforcement: the diagram service validates the raw PUT body and answers graph_invalid or graph_too_large; the model schemas state the shape
hard_errors: schema or version mismatch; unknown keys anywhere
malformed or duplicate IDs; a retired ID; a restored ID that fails the restoration rule
an edge whose from or to is not an existing node; a self-loop
unknown type, subtype, kind or boundary type; a node whose boundary does not exist

hashes.graph_hash: sha256 of canonical JSON of the whole learner graph
hashes.topology_hash: sha256 of structure and typing only

layout_rules: layout is never sent to a model, never part of a hash, never validated for meaning
unknown IDs in layout are dropped on save
a layout-only save changes layout and version, not graph_hash
string_rules: valid Unicode, NFC-normalized, leading and trailing whitespace trimmed
no control characters except a newline in an explanation
no bidirectional override or isolate characters (U+202A to U+202E, U+2066 to U+2069), no noncharacters
no unbroken run of non-whitespace longer than 256 characters (an abuse limit, not a security boundary)
learner text is stored and returned as inert JSON text, rendered only as text nodes

never_exported: secrets, keys, provider configuration, hidden prompts
ai_operation, ai_budget_period, job and idempotency rows, the deletion journal
content commit, plan or route at start, model IDs and metadata, rubric and prompt versions
diagram snapshot alias maps and born-version maps
reference or review sections and unrevealed authored material
export.order: header first, records, trailer last; no trailer means incomplete

open_items.OI-01: The answer to POST /consent while the required terms version is unset (fail closed): the consent service specifies it. GET /consent reports state required with a null required_version.
open_items.OI-04: The export of feedback (ExportFeedbackData.result) and every M2 and M3 shape stay PROVISIONAL.
